reasoning.decision: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "index"
reasoning.because: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "index": an index of tabs, so scenes slide in like the next tab. TikTok wants native editing, so hard cuts and whips lead.
Camera "dolly": constant forward movement for a high-energy feed.
Grounds light → light → ink → accent: a cool accent, so a darker ground is used for contrast at a turn.
Its shape was 0.74 similar to sit-home-management-companion-problem-1--tiktok; a different film, not the same one re-coloured.
Sound-on placement: every transition, landing and reveal has a cue, and the bed ducks under the brand moment.
Each scene is held for the time its words take to read on TikTok (0.24s a word), inside 12–35s.
